rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken expression for someone who sells something.

example.english: The seller at the market said today's vegetables are very fresh.
example.traditional: 街市嗰個賣嘢嘅人話今日啲菜好新鮮。
example.jyutping: gaai1 si5 go2 go3 maai6 je5 ge3 jan4 waa6 gam1 jat6 di1 coi3 hou2 san1 sin1

rows.note: Use this specifically for a shop or department-store sales clerk rather than any person who sells.

example.english: The department-store seller was very patient and explained each item to me.
example.traditional: 百貨公司嗰位售貨員好有耐性，逐件同我介紹。
example.jyutping: baak3 fo3 gung1 si1 go2 wai6 sau6 fo3 jyun4 hou2 jau5 noi6 sing3 zuk6 gin6 tung4 ngo5 gaai3 siu6

rows.note: Use this mainly for the person or business selling goods, especially in an online or commercial transaction.

example.english: Before placing an order online, I check the seller's reviews first.
example.traditional: 我喺網上落單之前，會先睇吓賣家嘅評價。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 mong5 soeng6 lok6 daan1 zi1 cin4 wui5 sin1 tai2 haa5 maai6 gaa1 ge3 ping4 gaa3
